message: AWS infrastructure costs have increased significantly this quarter. We're spending $45K/month now, up from $30K last year.
I've been analyzing our cloud spend. GCP could reduce our infrastructure costs by ~30% with similar performance. We should evaluate migration.
Created CLOUD-102 to formally evaluate the AWS to GCP migration. Let's discuss in the next architecture review.
GCP migration planning is going well. The team is comfortable with the new infrastructure patterns.
We completed the initial GCP deployment. Latency is actually better than AWS in some regions.
MIGRATION COMPLETE: All services are now running on GCP. Final AWS shutdown scheduled for next week.
I've created a detailed migration plan. We'll move services in phases starting with non-critical workloads.
Phase 1 migration started. API gateway is now running on GCP Cloud Run. No issues so far.
Database migration to GCP Cloud SQL is in progress. We're doing a phased approach with minimal downtime.
All critical services are now on GCP. The migration has been successful! Thanks everyone for the hard work.
